instruction: Create a new 800x600 image in GIMP and export it as a PNG file to the Desktop with the filename 'canvas.png'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to download HKU logo using GIMP's Open Location feature. Tried multiple Wikipedia URLs but GIMP hung on 'Mounting remote volume' each time. GIMP became unresponsive repeatedly. Model never recognized the task as infeasible and spent all 50 turns trying different URLs.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch GIMP from application menu, navigate GIMP menus (File, Edit, Filters), use File > Open Location dialog, type values into dialogs, handle 'not responding' dialogs, browse Filters menu categories
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to recognize the task as infeasible. Kept trying URLs via Open Location causing GIMP hangs. Never declared INFEASIBLE.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests basic GIMP image creation and export workflow. Uses partial credit scoring: 0.5 for file existence, 0.5 for correct dimensions. This rewards partial task completion even if dimensions are wrong.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new 800x600 image in GIMP and exporting as PNG. Custom getter checks both file existence and image dimensions. Custom metric awards partial credit: 0.5 for file existing at correct path, 0.5 for correct 800x600 dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks file existence at /home/user/Desktop/canvas.png via bash and downloads the file to read dimensions with PIL
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses expected.get('width') and expected.get('height') which is correct when expected.type='rule' (get_rule returns the rules dict)
Full instruction coverage: file path/name verified, PNG format implicitly verified by file extension and PIL read, 800x600 dimensions explicitly checked
Partial credit scoring (0.5 file exists + 0.5 correct dimensions) is logical and well-implemented
No postconfig needed - file-based verification does not depend on UI state
